series.name: LUNA2000-S1 ESS (LUNA2000-5/7/10/12/14/15/17/19/21-S1, LUNA2000-7/14/21-S1) numbered alarm table
series.notes: LUNA2000-S1 is the generation Huawei lists on the Pakistan site (LUNA2000-7/14/21-S1), so this is the most PK-relevant battery table. SEPARATE from SERIES 5 (S0) - same numeric codes, revised names and causes. Note the manual's own terminology mapping: 'battery power control module' = Energy Storage Control Unit, 'battery pack' = battery expansion module. Codes 3047 and 3071 are new in S1 (3047 is ABSENT from S1; 3071 is ABSENT from S0). Codes 3063-3066 and 3070 are new in S1.

aliases: Low battery DC input bus voltage

title.en: Low Battery DC Input Bus Voltage
title.ur: Battery DC input bus voltage kam hai

meaning.en: The battery DC bus is too low. Unlike S0, this manual adds inverter-side causes to the list.
meaning.ur: Battery DC bus bohat kam hai. S0 ke muqable mein is manual ne inverter side ki wajuhain bhi shamil ki hain.

causes.en: The inverter is faulty and pulls down the bus voltage.
causes.ur: Inverter faulty hai aur bus voltage neeche kheench raha hai.

causes.en: The DC bus voltage of the battery is low.
causes.ur: Battery ka DC bus voltage kam hai.

causes.en: The battery DC switch is OFF, or the battery cables are not correctly connected.
causes.ur: Battery DC switch OFF hai, ya battery cables theek se connected nahi hain.

solutions.en: Check for inverter fault alarms and clear them first - the manual lists a faulty inverter as cause 1.
solutions.ur: Pehle inverter ke fault alarms check karke clear karein - manual ne faulty inverter ko pehli wajah bataya hai.

solutions.en: Turn off inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch and battery DC switch, then wait 5 minutes.
solutions.ur: Inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch aur battery DC switch band karein, phir 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Check the battery power cable connections on the [Battery-1/2/3/4] control unit against the quick installation guide, then power up in sequence.
solutions.ur: [Battery-1/2/3/4] control unit par battery power cable connections ko quick installation guide se check karke sequence mein power up karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Section 7.3 Table 7-2

title.ur: Battery power control module (ESCU) abnormal hai

meaning.en: Major fault on the internal circuit of the Energy Storage Control Unit, or its internal communication is abnormal.
meaning.ur: Energy Storage Control Unit ke internal circuit par major fault hai, ya uski internal communication abnormal hai.

causes.en: A major fault has occurred on the internal circuit of the battery power control module.
causes.ur: Battery power control module ke internal circuit par major fault aaya hai.

causes.en: The internal communication of the battery power control module is abnormal (new second cause in S1).
causes.ur: Battery power control module ki internal communication abnormal hai (S1 mein nayi doosri wajah).

solutions.en: Power off all three switches and wait 5 minutes, then power up starting with the battery DC switch.
solutions.ur: Teeno switches band karke 5 minute intezaar karein, phir battery DC switch se power up karein.

solutions.en: Use the fault indicator state: the manual says a steady-on fault indicator on a specific module means the fault persists there.
solutions.ur: Fault indicator ki state use karein: manual ke mutabiq kisi specific module par steady-on fault indicator ka matlab hai ke fault wahan bana hua hai.

solutions.en: If it persists on one named module, record the module number and contact your vendor or technical support.
solutions.ur: Agar kisi ek module par bana rahe to module number note karke vendor ya technical support se rabta karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Section 7.3 Table 7-2

title.ur: Battery power control module overtemperature (garm ho gaya)

meaning.en: The Energy Storage Control Unit is running hot - poor ventilation, excessive ambient, or a module fault.
meaning.ur: Energy Storage Control Unit garm chal raha hai - ventilation kam, ambient zyada, ya module fault.

causes.en: The installation position of the battery power control module is not well ventilated.
causes.ur: Battery power control module ki installation position well ventilated nahi hai.

causes.en: The ambient temperature is excessively high.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature bohat zyada hai.

causes.en: The battery power control module is abnormal.
causes.ur: Battery power control module abnormal hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the specific [Battery-1/2/3/4] control unit is properly ventilated and whether ambient exceeds the upper threshold.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke mashoor [Battery-1/2/3/4] control unit well ventilated hai ya nahi aur ambient upper threshold se zyada to nahi hai.

solutions.en: Improve ventilation and heat dissipation before touching the module itself.
solutions.ur: Module ko chhune se pehle ventilation aur heat dissipation behtar karein.

solutions.en: If ventilation and ambient both meet requirements, contact your dealer or technical support - it is a module fault.
solutions.ur: Agar ventilation aur ambient dono requirements poore karte hain to dealer ya technical support se rabta karein - yeh module fault hai.

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Section 7.3 Table 7-2

aliases: Battery power control module fuse blown

title.en: Battery Power Control Module Fuse Blown
title.ur: Battery power control module ka fuse udd gaya

meaning.en: The fuse in the Energy Storage Control Unit has blown.
meaning.ur: Energy Storage Control Unit ka fuse udd gaya hai.

causes.en: Battery power control module fuse blown.
causes.ur: Battery power control module ka fuse udd gaya hai.

causes.en: An internal overcurrent or short inside the unit, which normally also damages the unit.
causes.ur: Unit ke andar overcurrent ya short, jo aam tor par unit ko bhi kharab kar deta hai.

solutions.en: Power off all three switches and wait 5 minutes.
solutions.ur: Teeno switches band karke 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Replace the fuse of the [Battery-1/2/3/4] control unit with the exact manual-specified rating.
solutions.ur: [Battery-1/2/3/4] control unit ka fuse manual mein diye gaye exact rating se badal dein.

solutions.en: Power up in sequence; if the replacement fuse also blows, stop - the module is damaged and needs RMA.
solutions.ur: Sequence mein power up karein; agar naya fuse bhi udd jaye to ruk dein - module kharab hai aur RMA chahiye.

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Section 7.3 Table 7-2

aliases: Battery power control module reversely connected

title.en: Battery Power Control Module Reversely Connected
title.ur: Battery power control module ulti polarity se connected hai

meaning.en: The Energy Storage Control Unit is connected to the inverter in reverse polarity.
meaning.ur: Energy Storage Control Module inverter se reverse polarity mein connected hai.

causes.en: The battery power control module is connected to the inverter in reverse polarity.
causes.ur: Battery power control module inverter se reverse polarity mein connected hai.

causes.en: Polarity is reversed on the DC bus cable run rather than at the module terminals, so the fault presents at the module even though the module's own wiring is correct.
causes.ur: Polarity module terminals par nahi, DC bus cable run mein uli hui hai, is liye module apni wiring sahi hone ke bawajood fault dikhata hai.

solutions.en: Do not power up. Isolate AC output switch, DC input switch and battery DC switch, then wait 5 minutes.
solutions.ur: Power up na karein. AC output switch, DC input switch aur battery DC switch isolate karke 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Check the battery cable connections on the [Battery-1/2/3/4] control unit against the quick installation guide.
solutions.ur: [Battery-1/2/3/4] control unit par battery cable connections ko quick installation guide se check karein.

solutions.en: Verify polarity with a DC voltmeter before re-energising, then power up in the manual's sequence.
solutions.ur: Dobara energise karne se pehle DC voltmeter se polarity verify karein, phir manual ke sequence se power up karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Section 7.3 Table 7-2

aliases: Battery power control module DC switch OFF

title.en: Battery Power Control Module DC Switch OFF
title.ur: Battery power control module ka DC switch OFF hai

meaning.en: The unit's own DC switch is off, so the battery pack is isolated from the system.
meaning.ur: Unit ka apna DC switch off hai, is liye battery pack system se isolate hai.

causes.en: The DC switch of the battery power control module is OFF.
causes.ur: Battery power control module ka DC switch OFF hai.

causes.en: The DC bus cable to the battery power control module is disconnected.
causes.ur: Battery power control module ka DC bus cable disconnect hai.

solutions.en: Power off all three switches and wait 5 minutes before touching the battery switch.
solutions.ur: Battery switch chhune se pehle teeno switches band karke 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Check the cable connections and the DC switch handle position on the named control unit.
solutions.ur: Mashoor control unit par cable connections aur DC switch handle ki position check karein.

solutions.en: Power up in sequence and confirm the pack reports online in the app.
solutions.ur: Sequence mein power up karke app par confirm karein ke pack online aa gayi hai.

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Section 7.3 Table 7-2

title.ur: Battery expansion module ka cable disconnect hai

meaning.en: The power cable to a battery expansion module is disconnected, so that pack drops out of the system.
meaning.ur: Battery expansion module ka power cable disconnect hai, is liye woh pack system se gir jata hai.

causes.en: The power cable to the battery expansion module is disconnected.
causes.ur: Battery expansion module ka power cable disconnect hai.

causes.en: The battery expansion module is abnormal.
causes.ur: Battery expansion module abnormal hai.

solutions.en: Power off all three switches and wait 5 minutes.
solutions.ur: Teeno switches band karke 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Check whether the power cable terminal is securely connected to the [Battery-1/2/3/4 expansion module-1/2/3].
solutions.ur: Check karein ke power cable terminal [Battery-1/2/3/4 expansion module-1/2/3] par securely connected hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Torque-check the terminal and confirm the pack count in the app matches the physical stack after restart.
solutions.ur: Terminal ka torque check karein aur restart ke baad app mein pack count physical stack se match karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Section 7.3 Table 7-2

title.ur: Battery expansion module overtemperature (garm ho gaya)

meaning.en: A battery pack is running hot - poor ventilation of the pack position or excessive ambient.
meaning.ur: Battery pack garm chal raha hai - pack ki position par ventilation kam ya ambient zyada.

causes.en: The installation position of the battery expansion module is not well ventilated.
causes.ur: Battery expansion module ki installation position well ventilated nahi hai.

causes.en: The ambient temperature is excessively high.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature bohat zyada hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the named expansion module position is properly ventilated and whether ambient exceeds the upper threshold.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke mashoor expansion module ki position properly ventilated hai ya nahi aur ambient upper threshold se zyada to nahi.

solutions.en: Improve ventilation and heat dissipation; verify the documented clearance on all sides is intact.
solutions.ur: Ventilation aur heat dissipation behtar karein; check karein ke chaaron taraf documented clearance bani hui hai.

solutions.en: Measure the flagged pack's surface temperature and compare with its neighbours to isolate a single-bad-pack case.
solutions.ur: Flagged pack ka surface temperature measure karke padosi packs se compare karein taake ek kharab pack ka case alag ho jaye.

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Section 7.3 Table 7-2

title.ur: Battery expansion module mein short circuit

meaning.en: A battery pack is short-circuited, or is abnormal. Fire-risk event - do not re-energise.
meaning.ur: Battery pack short-circuited hai ya abnormal hai. Aag ka khatra - dobara power na dein.

causes.en: The battery expansion module is short-circuited.
causes.ur: Battery expansion module short-circuited hai.

causes.en: A battery expansion module is abnormal.
causes.ur: Battery expansion module abnormal hai.

solutions.en: Power off all three switches and wait 5 minutes before approaching the pack.
solutions.ur: Pack ke paas jane se pehle teeno switches band karke 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: With DC isolated, measure each pack's terminal voltage and internal resistance to find the shorted pack.
solutions.ur: DC isolate kar ke har pack ka terminal voltage aur internal resistance measure karke shorted pack dhoondein.

solutions.en: Quarantine the shorted pack and contact the vendor; never bypass a pack to keep the system running.
solutions.ur: Shorted pack isolate karke vendor se rabta karein; system chalta rakhne ke liye pack bypass kabhi na karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Section 7.3 Table 7-2

meaning.en: A pack's voltage, or the pack input voltage, is too low to charge it. Recovery depends on available sunlight or permitted AC reverse charging.
meaning.ur: Pack ka voltage ya pack input voltage charge karne ke liye bohat kam hai. Recovery sunlight ya ijazat ki AC reverse charging par depend karta hai.

causes.en: The voltage of a battery expansion module is low.
causes.ur: Battery expansion module ka voltage kam hai.

causes.en: The input voltage of a battery expansion module is low.
causes.ur: Battery expansion module ka input voltage kam hai.

solutions.en: Confirm sunlight is sufficient or that AC reverse charging is allowed, as the manual conditions recovery on this.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke sunlight kaafi hai ya AC reverse charging ki ijazat hai, jaisa manual recovery ki shart lagata hai.

solutions.en: Measure the DC bus voltage at the control unit to see whether the input side can charge the pack at all.
solutions.ur: Control unit par DC bus voltage measure karein dekhne ke liye ke input side pack ko charge kar sakti hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Do not force-charge a deeply discharged pack; use the documented hibernation then wake sequence instead.
solutions.ur: Bohat discharge hua pack force-charge na karein; documented hibernation phir wake sequence use karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Section 7.3 Table 7-2

aliases: Abnormal battery power control module parallel communication

title.ur: Modules ke darmiyan parallel communication abnormal hai

meaning.en: The power control modules in a parallel system fail to communicate with each other.
meaning.ur: Parallel system ke power control modules aapas mein communicate nahi kar pa rahe.

causes.en: The battery power control modules of the parallel system fail to communicate with each other.
causes.ur: Parallel system ke battery power control modules aapas mein communicate nahi kar pa rahe.

causes.en: The communications cable is not correctly connected between paralleled systems.
causes.ur: Parallel systems ke darmiyan communications cable theek se connected nahi hai.

solutions.en: Issue a hibernation command on the app, then turn off inverter AC output switch, DC input switch and battery DC switch, and wait 5 minutes.
solutions.ur: App par hibernation command bhejein, phir inverter AC output switch, DC input switch aur battery DC switch band karke 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Check that the communications cable is correctly connected between the paralleled control units.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke paralleled control units ke darmiyan communications cable theek se connected hai.

solutions.en: Confirm in the app that only supported parallel counts are configured; the PK spec page caps parallel operation at 4 systems and only certain inverter models allow 4.
solutions.ur: App par confirm karein ke sirf supported parallel count configure hai; PK spec page parallel operation 4 systems tak limit karta hai aur sirf kuch inverter models 4 allow karte hain.

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Section 7.3 Table 7-2

title.en: Abnormal Communication With Battery Expansion Module
title.ur: Battery expansion module ke saath communication abnormal hai

meaning.en: The power control module fails to communicate with the battery expansion modules.
meaning.ur: Power control module battery expansion modules se communicate nahi kar pa raha.

causes.en: The battery power control module fails to communicate with the battery expansion modules.
causes.ur: Battery power control module battery expansion modules se communicate nahi kar pa raha.

causes.en: The communications cable terminal is loose or a pack is unpowered.
causes.ur: Communications cable terminal loose hai ya koi pack unpowered hai.

solutions.en: Power off all three switches and wait 5 minutes.
solutions.ur: Teeno switches band karke 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Check that the communications cable terminal is correctly connected to each [Battery-1/2/3/4 expansion module-1/2/3].
solutions.ur: Check karein ke communications cable terminal har [Battery-1/2/3/4 expansion module-1/2/3] par correctly connected hai.

solutions.en: Reseat and torque the communication terminals, then confirm each pack reports in the app before re-energising.
solutions.ur: Communication terminals dobara laga ke torque karein, phir dobara energise karne se pehle app par confirm karein ke har pack report kar rahi hai.

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Section 7.3 Table 7-2

aliases: Inconsistent Battery Power Control Module Versions

title.ur: Modules ke firmware versions inconsistent hain

meaning.en: The power control modules in a parallel system are running different firmware versions.
meaning.ur: Parallel system ke power control modules alag alag firmware versions par chal rahe hain.

causes.en: The versions of the power control modules in the parallel system are inconsistent.
causes.ur: Parallel system ke power control modules ke versions inconsistent hain.

causes.en: The update failed.
causes.ur: Update fail ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Open the app and read the firmware version of each control unit; note which one is behind.
solutions.ur: App kholein aur har control unit ka firmware version padhein; note karein ke kaun sa peeche hai.

solutions.en: Update the out-of-date unit to match the others, following the app's upgrade sequence.
solutions.ur: App ke upgrade sequence ke mutabiq peeche wale unit ko baqi ke barabar update karein.

solutions.en: If the update fails multiple times, contact your dealer or technical support rather than forcing it.
solutions.ur: Agar update kai baar fail ho to zor se karne ke bajaye dealer ya technical support se rabta karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Section 7.3 Table 7-2

title.en: ESS Version Mismatch (control unit vs pack)
title.ur: ESS version mismatch (control unit aur pack ke darmiyan)

meaning.en: The power control module firmware version does not match the battery pack version, which affects normal operation.
meaning.ur: Power control module ka firmware version battery pack ke version se match nahi karta, is se normal operation par asar padta hai.

causes.en: The version of the battery power control modules does not match that of the battery packs, which affects the normal operation.
causes.ur: Battery power control modules ka version battery packs ke version se match nahi karta, is se normal operation asar pata hai.

causes.en: The update failed.
causes.ur: Update fail ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Read both the control unit and each pack firmware version in the app and identify the mismatch pair.
solutions.ur: App par control unit aur har pack ka firmware version padhein aur mismatch jodi pehchan lein.

solutions.en: Run the app's ESS update so the control unit and packs converge on one version.
solutions.ur: App ka ESS update chalayein taake control unit aur packs ek version par aa jayein.

solutions.en: If the update fails multiple times, contact your dealer or technical support; a forced version skip can brick the pack.
solutions.ur: Agar update kai baar fail ho to dealer ya technical support se rabta karein; zor se version skip karne se pack brick ho sakta hai.

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Section 7.3 Table 7-2

title.ur: Battery pack ki lifespan khatam ho gayi

meaning.en: The named battery expansion module has reached the end of its life. Recycling is required, not repair.
meaning.ur: Mashoor battery expansion module ki zindagi khatam ho gayi. Recycling zaroori hai, maramm nahi.

causes.en: The battery pack has reached the end of its lifespan through ageing and cycling.
causes.ur: Battery pack ageing aur cycling ke zariye apni lifespan ke end tak pohanch gaya hai.

causes.en: No electrical or firmware fault is listed alongside it - this manual states ageing only, so it is a wear-out condition rather than a defect.
causes.ur: Iske saath koi electrical ya firmware fault listed nahi hai - yeh manual sirf ageing batata hai, is liye yeh defect nahi balki wear-out condition hai.

solutions.en: Confirm which pack position has reached end of life in the app before ordering a replacement.
solutions.ur: Replacement order karne se pehle app par confirm karein ke kaun si pack position ki lifespan khatam hui hai.

solutions.en: Check remaining usable capacity of the other packs; only one module may need replacing.
solutions.ur: Baaki packs ki bachi hui usable capacity check karein; ho sakta hai sirf ek module badalna ho.

solutions.en: Recycle the end-of-life pack through a compliant local recycler and keep the disposal record for warranty audit.
solutions.ur: End-of-life pack ko compliant local recycler se recycle karein aur warranty audit ke liye disposal record rakhein.

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Section 7.3 Table 7-2

aliases: Battery Power Control Module Certificate Expired

title.ur: Control unit ka certificate expire ho gaya

meaning.en: The control unit's certificate has expired, or the system time is set wrong so a valid certificate reads as expired.
meaning.ur: Control unit ka certificate expire ho gaya hai, ya system time galat hai is liye valid certificate expired dikh raha hai.

causes.en: The certificate has expired.
causes.ur: Certificate expire ho gaya hai.

causes.en: The system time is incorrectly set.
causes.ur: System time galat set hai.

solutions.en: Apply for a new certificate for the specific [Battery-1/2/3/4] unit.
solutions.ur: Mashoor [Battery-1/2/3/4] unit ke liye naya certificate apply karein.

solutions.en: Correct the system time of the unit, then reload the certificate.
solutions.ur: Unit ka system time theek karein, phir certificate dobara load karein.

solutions.en: Sync time automatically where possible so a manual clock drift does not re-trigger this.
solutions.ur: Jahan mumkin ho time automatically sync karein taake manual clock drift dobara yeh na chalaaye.

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Section 7.3 Table 7-2

aliases: Abnormal EN Signal on Battery Expansion Module

title.en: Abnormal EN Signal on Battery Expansion Module
title.ur: Battery expansion module ka EN signal abnormal hai

meaning.en: The EN (enable) cable of a battery expansion module is plugged into the wrong port.
meaning.ur: Battery expansion module ka EN (enable) cable galat port mein laga hua hai.

causes.en: The EN cable of the battery expansion module is connected to an incorrect port.
causes.ur: Battery expansion module ka EN cable galat port se connected hai.

causes.en: The battery expansion module is abnormal.
causes.ur: Battery expansion module abnormal hai.

solutions.en: Power off all three switches and wait 5 minutes before touching the EN cable.
solutions.ur: EN cable chhune se pehle teeno switches band karke 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Check whether the EN cable terminal is correctly connected to the power control module of the named expansion module.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke EN cable terminal mashoor expansion module ke power control module par correctly connected hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Re-seat the EN cable in the labelled port only, and confirm the pack reports in the app afterwards.
solutions.ur: EN cable sirf labelled port mein dobara laga dein, phir app par confirm karein ke pack report kar rahi hai.

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Section 7.3 Table 7-2

title.ur: ESS health check timeout ho gaya

meaning.en: The ESS has not received a health check for a long time, so battery health data is stale.
meaning.ur: ESS ko bohat arse se health check nahi mila, is liye battery health data purana hai.

causes.en: The ESS has not received a health check for a long time.
causes.ur: ESS ko bohat arse se health check nahi mila hai.

causes.en: Long grid outage or extended no-PV period preventing the scheduled check from running.
causes.ur: Lamba grid outage ya lamba no-PV arse jo scheduled check chalne se rok raha hai.

solutions.en: Perform a battery health check manually, as the manual's only listed measure.
solutions.ur: Manual ka sirf bataya hua ilaaj hai - battery health check manually karein.

solutions.en: Before the manual check, confirm the app can reach the ESS - this alarm often rides alongside a comms problem.
solutions.ur: Manual check se pehle confirm karein ke app ESS tak pohanch sakta hai - yeh alarm aksar comms problem ke saath aata hai.

solutions.en: If manual checks keep timing out, log SOH trends in the app to see whether a pack has genuinely degraded.
solutions.ur: Agar manual checks baar baar timeout hote hain to app par SOH trends log karein dekhne ke liye ke koi pack waqai degrade hua hai ya nahi.

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Section 7.3 Table 7-2

title.ur: Battery expansion module lock ho gaya

meaning.en: The expansion module is locked out, usually because of overheating or an internal major fault. The manual's listed action is vendor escalation.
meaning.ur: Expansion module lock out ho gaya hai, aam tor par overheating ya internal major fault ki wajah se. Manual ka bataya hua ilaaj vendor ko batana hai.

causes.en: The installation position of the battery expansion module is not well ventilated.
causes.ur: Battery expansion module ki installation position well ventilated nahi hai.

causes.en: The ambient temperature is above the upper threshold.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature upper threshold se upar hai.

causes.en: The battery expansion module is abnormal, or a major fault has occurred on it.
causes.ur: Battery expansion module abnormal hai, ya us par major fault aaya hai.

solutions.en: Correct the installation ventilation and ambient conditions first - these are listed causes, not guesses.
solutions.ur: Pehle installation ki ventilation aur ambient conditions theek karein - yeh listed wajuhain hain, andaza nahi.

solutions.en: Do not attempt to force-unlock the module; power off and leave it isolated while you escalate.
solutions.ur: Module ko force-unlock karne ki koshish na karein; band karke isolate chhod dein aur escalate karein.

solutions.en: Contact your vendor or technical support, quoting the alarm ID and the module position, as the manual directs.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq vendor ya technical support se rabta karein, alarm ID aur module position batayein.

source.title: LUNA2000-S1 User Manual, Issue 06 (2025-09-30), Section 7.3 Table 7-2
